recognize_zh: 這是小鼠脾臟的巨觀照片：表面突起多個界線清楚、顏色較淡的圓形結節，每個結節就是一個由單一移植造血幹/前驅細胞長成的脾臟群落（CFU-S，Till 與 McCulloch 實驗）。
features: Gross (black-and-white) photograph of an elongated mouse spleen
Multiple discrete, round, raised, pale macroscopic nodules on the splenic surface
Nodules vary in size and are separated by darker normal splenic parenchyma
Each nodule represents a clonal hematopoietic colony (CFU-S) formed after transplantation into an irradiated recipient
describe_en: Gross photograph of a mouse spleen shows multiple discrete, round, pale, raised nodules of varying size scattered over the capsular surface against darker background parenchyma. In the context of the spleen colony-forming unit assay, each nodule is a clonal colony arising from a single transplanted bone marrow progenitor in a lethally irradiated recipient, counted about 8 to 12 days after injection. This classic experiment by Till and McCulloch provided the first functional evidence of hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells with multilineage and self-renewal capacity. The image is experimental and not diagnostic of human disease.

ddx.vs: Infarcts are wedge-shaped, subcapsular and often pale or hemorrhagic with a base at the capsule, rather than round raised nodules in an irradiated host.

ddx.dx: Splenic involvement by lymphoma or metastatic tumor nodules
ddx.vs: Tumor nodules show atypical monomorphous cells on histology, whereas CFU-S colonies contain maturing erythroid, myeloid and megakaryocytic cells.
